Datatable.LocalizationPair: Specializing weaponry to counter enemy defenses is an important part of all warfare, and while it cannot make completely adaptive armaments, this armory can outfit ships with advanced "intelligent weapons" able to eke out that little bit of extra impact necessary to turn around an engagement.

Using liquid composites in plating has allowed us to not only make somewhat more effective armor, but also perform wargames using modified kinetic munitions; mass high-quality training becomes widespread, at the expense of mass bruising.
